summary: Iter-8 (F7 People-also-buy upsell) tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 14/14 pytest passed — POST /api/menu/upsell behaves per spec (default limit=4, cap=8, excludes input ids, prioritizes related_item_ids first, then bestsellers, then popular, fallback by recency, excludes stock=0, returns proper price/original_price/discount_percent/variations shape). related_item_ids round-trips on POST/PUT /menu-items and is returned by GET /menu-items defaulting to []. Iter-7 regressions (categories, /menu shape, online-settings) green. FRONTEND: /cart strip renders with title 'People also buy' + Sparkles icon, 4 upsell cards with proper testids (upsell-item-{id}, upsell-add-{id}), BEST + 25% OFF badges + Rs.600 strikethrough on Chicken Biryani (Full), Beef Biryani (in cart) is excluded from suggestions. Direct-add (no-variations) on /cart raised cart count 1->2->3 across two upsell-add clicks. /checkout shows compact PAB with title 'Add a side?' above Payment Method (after Continue-as-Guest), and adding from /checkout updated Order Summary live (Rs.450 -> Rs.900). Admin /admin/menu edit modal shows 17 menu-form-related-{id} chips (18-1 self), self exclusion verified, Save → Item updated toast. Variation-picker (data-testid=upsell-variation-picker) was not directly exercised because none of the 4 currently-bestseller/popular fallback items have variations — code path is verified by static review of PeopleAlsoBuy.jsx (lines 37-44, 119-155).
action_items: (LOW / iter-9) server.py is now 3326 lines — the deferred refactor into routers should be the first task. Add upsell to its own /app/backend/routers/upsell.py.

(LOW) The current bestseller/popular fixtures don't include any item with variations, so the upsell variation-picker path was verified only by static code review. Consider adding a variation-bearing item (e.g., a drink with size variations) to seed data so this flow can be e2e-tested in future iterations.

(LOW / NICE-TO-HAVE) PeopleAlsoBuy.jsx queries on every cart-id change — debounce or memoize when cartItemIds string identity changes only (currently triggers on add-then-remove same item). Not blocking.

(LOW) UpsellCard shows 'From Rs. {min}' for items with variations but the badge area still shows {discount_percent}% OFF / BEST based on the parent item — visually correct in our test (Chicken Biryani Full single-price), but if a variation-priced item is bestseller, the strikethrough won't render because original_price is computed against base price, not min(variation). Verify this once seed data is updated.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/menu/upsell ranking is correctly implemented and stable: explicit related_item_ids -> is_bestseller -> is_popular -> recency. Excludes input ids and stock=0. The `cart_oids` filter `len(x)==24` silently drops malformed ids — fine for safety.
Upsell serializer reuses the same price/discount math as /api/menu (server.py L2019-2031 vs L1989-2007). Good DRY-adjacent symmetry but consider extracting a helper to avoid drift.

PeopleAlsoBuy.jsx returns null when loading or when suggestions=[] (good — no empty box). Cart-id dependency uses Set+join so two variations of the same item dedupe to a single excluded id — matches the spec note in the review request.
AdminMenu.jsx openEdit() filters self id out of related_item_ids when loading existing data (L72) AND the chip render loop also skips self (L296 area). Defensive double-guard — good.
server.py is now 3326 lines (was 3239 in iter-7, 3174 in iter-6). The refactor deferral is the right call but is becoming urgent.
Note: The check `len(ranked) < limit` repeats 4 times in the upsell endpoint — could be one loop over priority-tiers, but readability is acceptable.
Toast/UX: PeopleAlsoBuy shows toast.success on direct-add but NOT after the variation-picker confirms — the picker calls onPick which calls toast.success itself (L65). Consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (cart PAB render, /cart no-variation upsell add, /checkout PAB compact + live total update, admin related-items chip toggle + save, self-exclusion). Variation-picker path verified by code review only.

seed_data_creation: All TEST_Iter8_* menu items created+deleted by pytest fixtures (cleaned up automatically). One AdminMenu chip toggle was saved persistently — main agent may want to revert if undesired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-8 is fully green. Upsell endpoint is POST /api/menu/upsell with body {item_ids:[...], limit:4} returning {items:[{id,name,price,original_price,discount_percent,image_url,is_bestseller,is_popular,variations}]}. PeopleAlsoBuy strip uses testids people-also-buy / upsell-item-{id} / upsell-add-{id} / upsell-variation-picker. AdminMenu form chip testid is menu-form-related-{id}. To test variation-picker upsell: seed an item with variations as a bestseller/popular OR set it as related_item of a cart item.
